payload.title: New Pretext site /api/media/*.mp4 returns 413 (videos do not play): media route must redirect to a presigned S3 URL like the old fork
payload.description: On the new Threat Intelligence site (app dzefa11i80jyq) every /api/media/**.mp4 returns HTTP 413 with an empty body (14 distinct URLs, Range requests too). The old live site answers 307 to a presigned S3 URL. Fix: media route redirects (307) to a short-lived presigned GET URL so S3 serves bytes and Range; IAM grant if missing; unit tests with a fake presigner in test:ci:ts; docs. Then roll out to the new TI app. See comment on PPY-4f2519 for evidence.
